messages:
elaine: Heads-up — legal pushed a change to the v2026 rate file that affects POC discounts. Please read.

miguel: link? where's the diff?

elaine: https://redwood-internal.storage/pricing/v2026/diff

kevin: tl;dr? Customer is asking for 3-month POC at 50% commit — is that allowed under the new slab?

zoe: Not by default. New ratecard introduces a strict floor for commit credits. POC exception needs Deal Desk approval and RevOps signoff.

sam: Legal flagged a clause around 'grandfathering'—we can approve grandfathered POCs only if signed MSA amendment exists. See snippet:
```
Section 4.b (POC Grandfathering): Customer commit credits not retroactive without Amendment A.
```

kevin: Customer is mid-contract renewal. Can we fast-track?

miguel: If it's under $40k ARR equivalent, I can approve with a manual override and log it. Above that goes to Deal Desk.

elaine: Can we get Deal Desk to pre-authorize exceptions for named strategic accounts? That would speed things.

deal-bot: New workflow created: /dealdesk request --type poc-exception --owner @miguel --notify @dealdesk

zoe: Suggest adding a temporary 'POC pilot' SKU (internal) for Q2 discounts — simplifies billing and doesn't touch main slabs.

sam: Legal prefers an Amendment + a clearly timeboxed pilot term. I'll draft a standard amendment template if we agree.

kevin: ok can someone confirm the final approval path? I need to tell the AE.

miguel: Path: RevOps (<$40k) -> Deal Desk (>$40k or strategic) -> Finance review -> Legal amendment sign. ETA 48-72h if docs ready.

elaine: I'll create a short internal FAQ and a decision matrix. Ping me any edge cases.

kevin: thanks — sending to the customer now with tentative timeline.

zoe: One more: if the AE wants to keep dedicated capacity (Dedicated) during POC, ratecard requires reserved capacity commit; that can't be exceptioned easily.

kevin: noted. I'll propose hosted/shared until commit is signed.

elaine: I'll post the FAQ in #sales-ops and tag Deal Desk when ready. :thumbsup:

miguel: Thanks all.
